Chapter 6862: Do Not Interfere With My Gift

Chapter 6862: Do Not Interfere With My Gift

Walking didn’t feel like walking since time and space were noticeably absent. The endless darkness earlier still had the concept of distance and time. The same couldn’t be said here.

Nevertheless, Li Qiye kept the two nearby, not allowing them to be lost forever. Eventually, they came across an existence in this void - the glimmer of the emperor’s saber.

Here, it was not blinding like the previous slash. As they came closer, they also saw scrap fragments floating in the void in the shape of a saber.

“This is Immortal Emperor Min Ren’s saber?” Thunder Emperor murmured.

The saber of a celestial immortal was anything but ordinary. One would find it difficult to find an equal in Heavenrealm. However, the pieces were more useless than scrap metal, devoid of any divinity.

“The emperor is dead.” The bear sighed.

“I see.” Sadness instantly overwhelmed Thunder, causing tears to moisten her eyes. Although she had zero connection with the emperor, Golden Lamp’s inhabitants worshipped him.

The battle occurred countless years in the past, but the legend remained. Now, it appeared he truly died in battle.

Li Qiye crouched and gently brushed the pieces away, revealing the saber’s light beneath. The other light could slay three thousand immortals without a problem. On the other hand, this flickering light was barely hanging on.

“What is it?” She asked, thinking that it wasn’t a regular gleam.

“The light as he gripped the saber.” Li Qiye said.

“Oh?” This was foreign to her.

“He had hope for peace and prosperity before the slash.” The bear said.

“Yes.” Li Qiye became emotional: “Many called him soft-hearted like a woman but in reality, he was the one with the blazing dao heart. It never gave up on this world and never abandoned the weak.”

“Immortal Emperor Min Ren.” She murmured his name, feeling that his dao heart was still warm despite having perished together with Mang.

“Is he truly dead?” The bear couldn’t help but ask.

“Yes, truly.” Li Qiye sighed and waved his hand.

“Boom!” A boundless primordial light filled the void to the brim.

They looked up and saw a primordial tree.

“It’s massive!” She had never seen anything like this before. The tree in the center of Golden Lamp was large, but it looked like a speck of dust compared to this one.

“This is the mother tree?” The bear couldn’t believe it. The size of this tree exceeded his imagination.

“Buzz.” Li Qiye conjured a river of life, allowing it to flow around the tree.

He then picked up the final gleam of the saber. This caused tribulations to form above.

“Damn!” The bear shouted.

Thunder became paralyzed on the ground, unable to handle the pressure.

“Villainous heaven, do not interfere with my gift today.” Li Qiye had a serious expression as he released his supreme will.

At the same time, he punched the air using his Ordinary Me Physique, piercing through the tribulation ocean.

This was his true power - a force capable of competing against the high heaven. Other immortals could only fight him in their dreams.
